claims.claim_text: The independently acquired dataset passed structural validation
Raw features have measured distribution differences relative to batch 1
All evaluated classical models have lower B10 than B2 accuracy
Expanding-window retraining improves mean accuracy for all evaluated models
IID diagnostic accuracy exceeds mean fixed-origin future accuracy for all evaluated models
Global drift has a consistent statistically supported association with performance
Some batch-2 predictive features combine above-median importance with below-median drift

Global permutation-importance (macro-F1) rankings and single-feature-ablation local explanations were generated for all four evidence-selected FIXED_ORIGIN models across all nine evaluation batches, with no unjustified explanation method forced onto an incapable model
Top-ranked features produced greater predictive degradation than matched random features for every tested model/method/batch/K combination.
Explanation fidelity was constant across chronological drift batches.
Explanation fidelity was equivalent for correct and misclassified predictions.
Top-K explanation rankings remain more similar across adjacent batches than widely separated anchor comparisons.
Explanation change increases as measured sensor-distribution shift increases across all eligible models.
Explanation stability differs between correct and misclassified predictions.
Physical sensor-level attribution change increases systematically with chronological input drift across eligible models.
Stage-10 fidelity and Stage-11 stability are positively associated across matched model/method analyses.
Local explanation methods differ materially in host computational overhead relative to corresponding baseline inference.
claims.required_evidence: At least one matched local-method overhead ratio differs by >=2x: True.

claims.claim_text: A substantial fraction of local ablation cost is explained by repeated model evaluations.
claims.required_evidence: Additional-call criterion=True; model-level Spearman rho=1.000, but positive bootstrap CI is not established with N=4 models.

claims.claim_text: Intrinsic extraction has lower recurring host cost than perturbation-based generation within comparable global scope.
claims.required_evidence: Intrinsic extraction is below permutation p05 for both applicable models: True.

claims.claim_text: No single method dominates simultaneously on fidelity, stability, and host computational cost.
claims.required_evidence: Stage-10/11 method coverage is incomplete for a fully matched dominance test; no universal composite score was constructed.

claims.claim_text: MODEL-C1 standalone FP32 implementation reproduces the frozen reference within all Stage-13 criteria.
MODEL-C4 standalone FP32 implementation reproduces the frozen reference within all Stage-13 criteria.
MODEL-C1 local coefficient explanation is reproduced within separately frozen explanation criteria.

decisions.interpretation: Explanation generation is executed but fidelity and stability are not established
decisions.decision: Register Stage 09 and retain later claims as planned

decisions.observation: Fidelity evidence is positive on average but heterogeneous across model method batch K scope and error condition.
decisions.interpretation: Rankings often identify model-dependent inputs, but no universal explanation-fidelity claim is supported.
decisions.limitations: Mean-reference perturbations may be off-manifold; ablation consistency is partly circular; selected local samples are not the full population.
decisions.decision: Proceed to Stage 11 only as a separate preregistered stability experiment while preserving method-specific fidelity caveats.

decisions.observation: Global and local stability are method model scale and context dependent; all broad candidate claims remain unsupported.
decisions.interpretation: Stability cannot substitute for fidelity; cross-batch explanations change substantially and relationships to input drift are model specific.
decisions.limitations: No repeated identical events; selected audit samples; no concentration matching; some undefined constant-vector correlations.
decisions.decision: Preserve mixed and negative evidence; permit preregistration of Stage 12 without changing Stage 10 or 11 claims.

decisions.observation: Host cost is reproducibly heterogeneous; intrinsic global extraction is static and cheap, while ablation and permutation costs are dominated by repeated frozen-model evaluation.
decisions.interpretation: The evidence is sufficient to freeze an embedded export protocol, but it does not establish MCU latency, memory, energy, or feasibility.
decisions.limitations: One workstation; warm steady state; permutation uses preregistered 256-sample stratified subsets; no physical hardware measurements.
decisions.decision: PROCEED TO EMBEDDED EXPORT PROTOCOL; do not execute export or hardware stages automatically.

decisions.observation: C1 and C4 preserved all golden/boundary decisions and model output tolerances but failed frozen preprocessing criteria; C1 XAI failed its relative criterion.
decisions.interpretation: Standalone FP32 arithmetic is decision-stable on the frozen set, but the full candidate cannot be called equivalent under preregistered rules.
decisions.limitations: Host x86-64 compilation only; strict relative errors near zero; no Cortex-M execution or resource measurement.
decisions.decision: REPAIR C1 EXPORT AND REPAIR C4 EXPORT via separately frozen preprocessing investigation; do not loosen tolerances or authorize quantization.

hardware_blocker: No nRF52840 firmware measurement or PPK2 trace is registered.
